properties.name: CityPlace
properties.description: The CityPlace mixed-use shopping center was completed in 2000. Current tenants include H&M, Lululemon, Eataly and Starbucks.

properties.name: The Laurel
properties.description: The 21-story, 322-unit apartment building was completed in 2024.

properties.name: Hilton West Palm Beach
properties.description: Related Ross developed the first Palm Beach County Convention Center Hotel in 2016 and now leases the property from the county.

properties.name: Curio Collection by Hilton
properties.description: Related Ross has plans to sell the property, a parking lot, to the county for $26 million, which it will lease back for up to 97 years. The developer plans to raise a second convention center hotel on the site. The plan passed local government approvals but faces a lawsuit from residents opposing the development.

properties.name: 360 Rosemary
properties.description: The 20-story, 313,000-square-foot office building was completed in 2021. Its tenants include JPMorgan Chase, Day Pitney and Comvest Partners.

properties.name: 10 CityPlace
properties.description: The 470,000-square-foot office tower is under construction, along with its sister building 15 CityPlace.

properties.name: 15 CityPlace
properties.description: The 490,000-square-foot, 25-story office tower is under construction, along with its sister, building, 10 CityPlace.

properties.name: 477 Rosemary
properties.description: The 80,000-square-foot, three-story offices are part of the CityPlace development, completed in 2000.

properties.name: Restoration Hardware Gallery
properties.description: The 80,000-square-foot, four-story furniture store features a rooftop restaurant.

properties.name: 515 Fern
properties.description: The 25-story building is planned for 456,000 square feet of office and 15,000 square feet of retail. It's expected to be the largest office building in downtown West Palm Beach upon completion, according to the Related Ross website.

properties.name: CityPlace Tower
properties.description: The 300,000-square-foot, 18-story office tower was originally developed by the Related Companies, then sold in 2008. Related Ross paid $175 million to buy it back in 2021.

properties.name: Residences at 464 Fern Street
properties.address: 430, 440, 450, 460 and 464 Fern Street, 419 and 435 Gardenia Street, and 415, 417 and 421 South Dixie Highway
properties.description: Earlier this year, Ross joined Wexford Real Estate Investors, 13th Floor Investments and L&L Holding Company in looking to develop a condo project on the site. A Related Ross affiliate bought the properties from its partners for $55 million in May.

properties.name: 209 North Sapodilla Avenue
properties.description: Plans for the site, proposed under the Live Local Act, include 191 affordable apartment units and nine affordable for-sale townhomes.

properties.name: One Flagler
properties.description: The 25-story, 273,000-square-foot tower was completed last year. Its tenants include Wells Fargo and Bessemer Trust.

properties.name: Edgeworth
properties.description: Related Ross does not own the property but is developing the Edgeworth condo tower, according to property records. The site hosts West Palm Beach's Family Church. The developer plans to buy the land from the church, though the deal hasn't closed, the Palm Beach Post reported.

properties.name: South Flagler House
properties.description: The 28-story, 108-unit condo tower is scheduled for completion in 2027. It was designed by Robert A.M. Stern Architects and marked that firm's first luxury residential project in Florida.

properties.name: Shorecrest
properties.description: Related Ross scored a $157 million construction loan for 98-unit condo building this year. Sales launched in 2024 with units starting at around $3 million.

properties.name: Phillips Point
properties.description: Ross paid $282 million for the 448,914-square-foot office towers in 2021. The building landed leases with investment bank Solomon Partners and analytics firm MSCI earlier this year.

properties.name: Esperanté Corporate Center
properties.description: Ross bought an interest in the 256,000-square-foot, 17 story office complex in 2021. Tenants include Bank of America and TurboTax.

properties.name: 3906 Washington Road and 3907 South Flagler Drive
properties.description: Related Ross acquired the multifamily properties next door to the Southbridge condos in a swap with Fort Partners. Related Ross simultaneously sold a separate property, the Harbor Towers condo, to Fort for $20 million shortly after the two settled a lawsuit over the Harbor property.

properties.name: Majority of Southbridge Condo
properties.description: A Ross-affiliated entity owns 59 of the 63 units as of Oct. 16, according to property records.

properties.name: One Clearlake
properties.description: The 18-story office tower spans 221,000 square feet. Related Ross bought the building from from Chicago-based Bradford Allen Investment Advisors for $55.4 million last year.

properties.name: Boca Raton Innovation Campus (BRiC)
properties.description: Management of BRiC's ownership entity transferred to Related Ross in September. A deed hasn't been recorded. The 124-acre campus has historical significance for hosting IBM’s invention of its first personal computer.

properties.name: Village Landing
properties.description: The 71-acre space, of which Ross purchased a portion this year, is set to feature retail, restaurants, offices and a hotel, along with a nearby private school.

properties.name: The Ben Hotel (Marriott’s Autograph Collection)
properties.description: Related Ross secured a $172.5 million loan from Tokyo-based Nomura to buy the 208-room hotel this year. It operates under the Marriott Autograph Collection.

properties.name: Hibiscus House
properties.description: Related Ross acquired the historic house, built in 1920, for $2.2 million in 2021. Also known as the Grant Van Valkenburg House, it was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1999.

properties.name: WPTV Building
properties.description: Related Ross acquired the two-story, 70,100-square-foot broadcast building from Scripps last year. It was built in 2000.

properties.name: North 40
properties.description: Related Ross picked up a second Boca Raton office property in October from Mainstreet Capital Partners and Partners Group. The two buildings measure 354,380 square feet of offices on 23.1 acres. It's located across the street from BRiC.
